tools.name: isolated_exec
tools.description: Run an ordinary local test in a private network and PID namespace. The ordinary shell retains its current restrictions. Use this tool for TCP or a bounded isolated run; start all communicating processes within the same invocation. Returns execution output, not an audit verdict. cwd is relative to this run working copy. No background service survives an invocation. Complete raw logs are retained read-only.
